Justice waits for no man... goblin... bah, just get on it!

objectives.text: Take down 10 Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of Gadgetzan, then report back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.

complete.text: You brought all that I asked.  Now, I will do my part...

progress.text: Do you have the items on my scroll, $N?

accept.text: It is said that, before her death, Velora Nitely was one of the finest armorsmiths in Lordaeron.  Death, it seems, has not decreased her talents.  Speak with Velora--she will make your brutal legguards.$B$BVelora plies her trade in the Undercity of Lordaeron, in the trade quarter.

objectives.text: Speak with Velora Nitely in the Undercity.

accept.text: To make the brutal leg guards, I need a brace of sturdy shinbones.  The Dragonmaw orcs of the Wetlands have nice, thick shinbones.  I'll need theirs.$B$BBut they must be sturdy.  Be sure to test the shinbones as you collect them.  If you can break them with your bare hands, then they won't be sturdy enough to work with.

objectives.text: Bring 8 Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones to Velora Nitely in the Undercity.

complete.text:
I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, $N.  Here is the product of your toil.

May you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.

accept.text: We mages have a task that needs doing.  One that is vital to the safety of Stormwind and Elwynn forest.$B$BJennea Cannon has the details.  She studies in the wizard's sanctum, in the mage district of Stormwind.  You should make your way to her with haste.

objectives.text: Speak with Jennea Cannon in Stormwind.

complete.text:
Quiet!  I'm in a delicate juncture and mustn't be disturbed!

One moment...

accept.text: The building of a mage's wand is not easy.  Rare substances are required, and a vessel must be made that can store great quantities of magical energy.  You must gather these things and bring them to me.$B$BI have written onto this parchment that which you need, and instructions on how to get it.  Bring me exactly what is on this list, and follow my written directions to the letter, for if you do not then when we make your wand things might go... badly.

objectives.text: Bring 1 Jade and the Bolt Charged Bramble to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

accept.text: To make your wand, there are key passages in a certain book that I must read.  The book is called Rituals of Power, written by the Magus Tirth.$B$BI do not have a copy of his book, and none of the world's great libraries possess it.  So you must speak with Tirth and gain it from him.$B$BGood luck.  Tirth used to be a great mage and scholar, but now he spends his time at the gnome and goblin races in the Shimmering Flats, drinking and gambling.

objectives.text: Speak with Magus Tirth in the Shimmering Flats.

complete.text:
Ah, yes.  You are here for an orb or a staff, $N?  Very well.  I will aid you in its construction.

But be forewarned--the process is a perilous one and could mean your death.

Or my death.  Definitely someone's death... 

But let's hope it's someone else's death, eh?

accept.text: The first step is to acquire an orb with power.  The warlocks of the Burning Blade have nice, high quality orbs... it's too bad they've bound demons into them!  But we can fix that, yes we can.$B$BGo to Desolace and snatch an infernal orb from a Burning Blade summoner.  You'll find summoners at the Mannoroc Coven.$B$BWhen you have the orb, return to me.

objectives.text: Bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

accept.text: Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!$B$BMy best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.$B$BTo find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!

complete.text:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?

objectives.text: Speak with Innkeeper Farley at the Lion's Pride Inn.

accept.text: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps.  They grow in clusters, deep in the Uldaman dig site; they may be elsewhere, but for now that's the only place I know they're at.  I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.$B$BFind the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps.  Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.$B$BDo this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of my greater mender's potion for you!

objectives.text: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

accept.text: $n, I could use your aid if you're up for it.  I am an alchemist of some note, and I seek your aid in acquiring some reagents found out in the Badlands.$B$BI need the following items to replenish my stocks: five buzzard gizzards, ten crag coyote fangs, and five rock elemental shards.  Obviously, you can get them off of the beasties themselves; if you're not the fighting type, then find friends who are.$B$BAcquire these items for me, you'll get some coin out of the deal.  Watcha wanna do?

complete.text:
Ah, well done!  These should last me for a little while, at least.  Here is your pay as promised.

If you're interested, I have some more reagents I could use.  These, however, are only found in the depths of the Uldaman excavation.  They will not be easy to get, but I will make it worth your while if you are interested in helping me again.

Perhaps something more than some shiny coins, yes?

objectives.text: Bring 5 Buzzard Gizzards, 10 Crag Coyote Fangs, and  5 Rock Elemental Shards to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath, Badlands.

progress.text: Have you gotten the things I need yet?  You won't get paid unless you bring me those reagents.

The voice of the stone watcher seems to resonate within your very inner being:

"You must first satisfy the data assimilation prerequisite of Discs of Norgannon; once you fulfill this requirement, you will then be permitted to obtain a portable version of the stored data.  Please be sure you have fully explored the information within this repository first."

accept.text: Touching the Discs of Norgannon once again makes your hand tingle.  This time, however, a strange grinding noise is heard from inside the discs.$B$BYour backpack suddenly becomes heavier than it was before.  Inside, you discover a miniature version of the discs!$B$BNo doubt, an item of this sort would be invaluable for someone interested in the ancient history of Azeroth.  The sages of Thunder Bluff are such historians, known throughout the Horde; perhaps they can make good use of it.

complete.text:
What are these here then?

Impressive, young one!  These discs, in them I sense secrets that the earth has held on to tightly for many years.  You were very wise to bring them here to me.

objectives.text: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.

progress.text: Yes young one, I see you marching into my tent with intensity in your stride... with determination in your purpose.  You seek my counsel is some matter of grave importance to the Horde?  Perhaps you wish a mystery of the universe revealed to you?

accept.text: We've got work for you, that is if you've got the guts to do it!$B$BDeep in the Badlands is the Uldaman dig site.  We've heard a tale about some idiot paladin who died there recently.  Why we even care is that he had a very valuable necklace on him.  It's supposedly got three large gems: a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz.$B$BThe shot: we want it, and we're payin' TOP SILVER to get it.  It may be damaged, but that's neither here nor there; we'll fix whatever scratches are on it.

complete.text:
Mmmm salvage!  I can smell the necklace from here.  Now let's look at that beauty...

Hey, what do you think you're trying to do here?  This necklace is missing the gems!  You think we wouldn't notice?  Even Malton could see that the gems are gone.

Well, maybe you didn't steal them... but this necklace is worthless without those gems!  Your job isn't done here yet, not by a long shot!

objectives.text: Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.  The necklace may be damaged.

progress.text: Well, do you have the necklace?  You won't see a copper from us if you don't have that necklace!

accept.text: As sure as Malton is a dummy, those gems are still in Uldaman somewhere.  You're going to have to go back there and look for them.$B$BLike I said before, if the information we have is correct then there's a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz that go with the necklace.  Find them and put them in the necklace.$B$BAs to where the gems are, who knows?  Maybe you'll get lucky and find the corpse of the Paladin.  If he's not been stripped clean already, then maybe he's got them on him still.

objectives.text: Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.

accept.text: Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett!  I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.$B$BThe Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers.  Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.$B$BReclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me!  Help me restore my birthright!

objectives.text: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.

progress.text: The sweeping never ends... these bats are prolific in their mockery of me and my broom.  Please tell me you've reclaimed my family's treasure!  I've offered you my silver - is that not enough?!

accept.text: A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves.  They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from Uldaman.  I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly.  It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site!$B$BAnyway, after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in Uldaman.$B$BI want those stones for myself!  Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!

objectives.text: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.

progress.text: Do you have the power stones, $N?  I have a robotic rodent that needs a power supply...

accept.text: I shall focus my energies on these discs; they will reveal their true workings to me in due time.$B$BAs for you $n, I will now reward you for your diligence in bringing this to my attention.  Take this voucher to Bena Winterhoof, the alchemy trainer for Thunder Bluff.  She will give you a special item I believe you will find appealing, and she will supply you with a choice of potions from my personal stock.$B$BReturn to me soon, as I sense there is much more at hand for us to do regarding this find.

complete.text: Well $N, you must have pleased Sage Truthseeker greatly for him to give you this item.  You are also to be granted a gift from his cache of potions; you may choose between 5 superior healing potions or 5 greater mana potions as your reward.

objectives.text: Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.

progress.text: Greetings, $c!  Are you here for alchemy training, or perhaps something else?

accept.text: Hmm, an interesting tale, and not one to be taken lightly. Yeah, I can help you, but what you need to do is divvy out a form of justice that's not... legal, if you're to see this through to the end.$B$BLescovar and Marzon need to be dealt with, and swiftly. Do you think you're capable of such a thing?$B$BYou decide. If so, then make haste to the castle and find an old friend of mine, a gnome named Tyrion. He's been watching Lescovar now for a couple weeks. He should be able to help you end this.

complete.text:
What the...?! Don't sneak up on me like that! And keep your voice down! What in the name of the Shadow are you doing sneakin' up on me for? Can't you see I'm busy, you daft fool?

What do you mean, what am I doing? I'm waiting for the next Dark Portal to open, what the heck do you think I'm doing? Speak your peace and be off with you... 'fore the guards notice the two of us hiding in the bushes together. I have a reputation to maintain.

objectives.text: Speak to Tyrion in Stormwind Castle.

accept.text: Trias wants the timetable pushed up some, huh? Okay, we can do that, but I'm not ready. And know this, I'm doing the hard part, but you're the one that's going to get $g his:her; hands dirty, understand? Good.$B$BOkay, I'll need you to get me a few things before I can put my plan into effect. I got the perfect disguise that'll get Spybot past those guards.$B$BBring me some silk and a couple apples. The silk's up to you, but Clara's little farm right outside the city has the perfect sized apples.

objectives.text: Bring 3 Silk Cloth and 2 of Clara's Fresh Apples to Tyrion in Stormwind.

progress.text: Show me your dedication, skyborne.

accept.text: Sergeant Bly stole from me!  He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!!  Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes??$B$BFind Bly and bring me my rod!  I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west.  I bet you'll find him there.$B$BLet's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.

complete.text: You found it!  Well done, $N!  Did you have to fight Bly for it?  I hope you knocked him and his band down good and hard!

objectives.text: Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: Did you find Sergeant Bly?  Did you get my divino-matic rod?

accept.text: Deep in Zul'Farrak, the sand troll city in Tanaris, there is a sacred pool.  From that pool the trolls summon a huge beast!  Gahz'rilla!  He's so fierce that even his scales crackle with energy.  It's that energy I want to harness for my car!$B$BBring me the electrified scale of Gahz'rilla!$B$BBut the summoning of Gahz'rilla is a well-kept secret of the trolls.  To face him, you must first wrest the secret from them.

complete.text:
Wow, you got the scale!  Thanks, $N.  I can't wait to get to work on this thing!

So you saw Gahz'rilla?  Was he as big as they say??

objectives.text: Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.

progress.text: Do you have the scale?  I can't wait to try different ways to harness its energy!

accept.text: I take pride in my leather work, and I feel it shows; quality should never be compromised.  Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter would also have you believe that the earth does not keep secrets!$B$BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have discovered thick yeti hides.  Yetis are native to Feralas, often found west of here in Feral Scar Vale.  I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten.  If that is agreeable to you, then we are set!

complete.text:
Ah, excellent!  These hides, when given a special treatment, are as resilient as iron I tell you!  It will take many tries in order to get the right mix down for the tanning, but I am confident they will bring my mark of quality to the next level.

As for you, $N... your assistance has proven invaluable to me.  Please take your choice from these items I have crafted.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

progress.text:
Were you able to get a stack of ten thick yeti hides?  My leather goods are second to none, and I'll share a sampling with you should you have the hides.

If you can't seem to find yetis, I know where some might be.  Try looking west of here, just inland of the Forgotten Coast around the Feral Scar Vale.

accept.text: Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, $n!$B$BUnfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.$B$BDo whatever you have to do to get that combination, $n. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!

complete.text:
I knew you could do it, $N! Sovik on the other hand, he had his doubts.

<Nogg clears his throat.>

Now that we have the blueprints in our possession, it is only a matter of time before we figure out all of the gnomish innovations that went into the creation of the rig and make them goblin innovations for our new shredder models.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Rig Blueprints and Thermaplugg's Safe Combination from Gnomeregan and bring them to Nogg in Orgrimmar.

progress.text: I don't see any blueprints. Did you hide them somewhere on your body or are you just standing around here to irritate me?

accept.text: As soon as we got word from Kernobee about the new gnomish rig, Scooty and I began work on the Transpolyporter 6000: The fastest and most reliable way to Gnomeregan.$B$BIt's finally ready for passengers to board, $n. If you want to give it a try, go to Booty Bay and talk with Scooty at the wind rider roost. To get to Booty Bay, take the boat from Ratchet.$B$BOf course, you could always try and make the run to Gnomeregan through the dwarf infested mountains of Dun Morogh!

complete.text:
She's a beauty, isn't she? Pinnacle of goblin transport technology -- only exploded a dozen or so times.

Don't worry, $N, I've got her all fixed up. She won't blow up on you - and if she does, it'll be quick and painless.

objectives.text: Speak with Scooty in Booty Bay.

accept.text: As long as you have the transponder in your possession, all you need to do is step on the pad and you'll be teleported to Gnomeregan.$B$BYou may experience some unusual side effects, but none of those should be permanent... anymore.$B$BI almost forgot the most important part - getting back. When you're ready to come back, just step on the transpolyporter pad in Gnomeregan!$B$BNow to calibrate the transponder to your size and weight.

complete.text: All done! When you're ready, just step on the pad.

objectives.text: Wait for Scooty to calibrate the Goblin Transponder.

accept.text: Long ago I possessed a beautiful piece of jewelry, the Tiara of the Deep.  And not only was it pretty--it held great power for those with the knowledge to use it.$B$BSo when word of the tiara reached the Hydromancer Velratha, she had to have it.  She sent agents to my home and they stole it while I was away.  The thieves!$B$BI want my tiara back!  Go to Zul'Farrak, the troll city in Tanaris, find Velratha and wrench the tiara from her.  Return it to me and you'll earn my favor.

complete.text:

The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!"  The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.

progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!

accept.text: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of an ancient egg.  It is a relic of a time when trolls ruled vast empires, and it has the power to hold the essence of Hakkar.  It may be the only way to keep our world safe from his evil.$B$BBring me the ancient egg, $n.  It is said to lay hidden deep within Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, in a cave behind the amphitheater at the top of the city.

objectives.text: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

accept.text: Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him.  That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.$B$BIf you're interested then speak with Eagan.  He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.

complete.text: That's true.  I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves!  Are you that person?

objectives.text: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

accept.text: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.$b$bWhen you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.

complete.text:
What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.

Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!

objectives.text: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.

accept.text: So you can see the predicament that I'm in, $n. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.$B$BIt is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

accept.text: I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.$B$BI've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.

complete.text:
Excellent! Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.

Thank you and farewell.

objectives.text: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.

progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.

complete.text:
Ah, this horn belongs to a Tauren, Roon Wildmane.  He and I had a good time hunting the beasts of Desolace.  So Roon is inviting me back, is he?

We're neck deep in the jungle right now, but thank you, $N.  Perhaps my next expedition will take me back to Desolace, the land of the centaurs.

progress.text: Sit, $c.  Soon enough you'll strike back into the jungle.

accept.text: As a tauren, it is important to follow the traditions of our ancestors by fighting mighty creatures. By besting these creatures, we are able to intake their spirits, allowing us to become closer to the Earthmother.$B$BIn the same way, taming a beast to fight alongside us helps us become one with nature around us. Eventually, you will learn to tame a beast of your choosing. But all things take practice, and you have much to learn. Begin by taking this taming rod; you must tame an adult plainstrider.

objectives.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

accept.text: My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.$B$BMarla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband.  So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.$B$BSamuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell.  Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.

complete.text: You have done a good deed today, $N.  Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place. As a token of my gratitude, please take one of these manuals I found.

objectives.text: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

accept.text: Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.$B$BHis presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.$B$BFind Malcin and slay him, $n. Return to me after the deed is done.

objectives.text: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

accept.text: My Lady,$B$BYou know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.$B$BPlease, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.$B$BBest Regards,$BAmbassador Malcin

complete.text:
I recognize the insignia on this scroll, $N. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.

The Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... changed.

If the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.

objectives.text: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

progress.text: What business is it you wish to speak of, $N? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.

accept.text: The crystal caverns of Terramok lie to the west, deep within Maraudon... It is an ancient place with much history. And I am looking to get my hands on some of it, $c. Relics of the old gods lie hidden behind the giant doors.$B$BIf you are willing to brave the twisted evils found in Maraudon, I believe I can make it worth your time. Collect the theradric crystal carvings you find, and return them to me.$B$BOnce I get the carvings, I will be able to... study them. These powers have been too long at rest...

complete.text:
Ha ha ha! I knew you'd be back.

<Willow mutters.>

...So easy to convince.

...Will do anything for the right price. Heh heh heh...

objectives.text: Collect 25 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

progress.text:
Don't ask questions!

You have my request.

accept.text: A satyr known as Vyletongue has corrupted the caverns of Maraudon, stunting the growth of many of the plants inside.$B$BTake this vial, $n. Fill it at the orange crystal pool found inside the caverns; the coating inside the vial will counter the toxins, turning it into a healing agent.$B$BFind the Vylestem vines inside the orange caverns, and use the purified liquid on them. The corruption will be purged from the plant, but do know that Vyletongue will still control it. He may use it against you...

complete.text:
Thank you for returning this, $N. With the remaining liquid you brought me, I can continue my studies.

While there is still much to do, you have helped to heal some of the corruption that Vyletongue spread through Maraudon. Please take this with my gratitude.

objectives.text: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.$B$BUse the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.$B$BHeal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

progress.text: If you are able to heal the plant, it will again begin to grow. We must do what we can, $N...

accept.text: A dark satyr called Lord Vyletongue spread his evil through these twisting caves, poisoning the minds of all inside. He still resides beyond the purple crystals.$B$BVyletongue also created a living symbol of his corruption called Noxxion that dwells beyond the orange crystals. Together, they have stolen the two parts of my brother's scepter. Celebras, my brother... he wanders blindly inside, cursed by corruption.$B$BYou must help him! Find the pieces, and speak to my brother... somehow.

complete.text: Now that you have recovered the two parts of my scepter, I have hope that Maraudon may one day be rid of the Vyle corruption.

objectives.text: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.$B$BFind a way to speak with Celebras.

progress.text: I have awoken from a nightmare that seemed it would never end...

accept.text: My scepter was once a source of hope for me. Its power allowed me the freedom to travel quickly through these caverns. I had hoped to bring peace to the spirit of my uncle... It is a task that I now pass to you.$B$BFor the two parts to once again become one, I will need your assistance in performing the ritual. Please follow me, and listen to my instructions while I channel the energy required to reunite the rod with the diamond.$B$BTogether, we shall create the Scepter of Celebras once again!

objectives.text: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.$B$BSpeak with him when the ritual is complete.

accept.text: Deep in Maraudon lives an evil creature of chaos--Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth related to the Old Gods. Ages ago, she and Zaetar, first son of Cenarius, began a relationship. The offspring of their time together became known to the people of Kalimdor as centaur. Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now hold Zaetar's remains. My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay Theradras so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.

complete.text:
This is most wonderful news, $N! Thank you!

I will speak with Marandis and ask his wisdom on the topic of Zaetar's remains, but at least you have overcome the hardest of the tasks.

I was told that if we were successful in our mission, I had permission to reward those who aided us. I was given these items as tokens from our people--you may choose one.

objectives.text: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

accept.text: The misbegotten centaur--my sons and daughters--have need of their father.$B$BLook around you--this place rings of hope and all that my father Cenarius preaches. It sprung from me! And I cannot take that away from them... not even for their crimes against me.$B$BBut there is one thing I would ask of you to ease my brother's mind. Take this... it is the first seed that fell from the life my remains nourished. Tell him my spirit remains here, and that I live on. I am sure he will understand.

objectives.text: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

accept.text: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.$B$BThe task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.$B$BIf you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.

objectives.text: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

progress.text: What did you decide, $N? Can you help me? Will you set foot on holy ground to help me forge one great centaur tribe!?

accept.text: Strong magics be found in the centaur holy place... the holy place of Maraudon. The Desolace tribes of centaur protect that place wit' their lives, but they canna stop us from takin' what we need.$B$BYou, you head to this Maraudon place and find the rock creatures made of shadowshard. You bring me the purple crystals, and Uthel'nay make you somethin' for your time.$B$BThe place be dangerous, so maybe you be bringing some friends.

complete.text: Ah, these be perfect for me magics. Here, you take one of these trinkets and be on your way... me got much studyin' to do.

objectives.text: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

progress.text: You find the crystals yet? Rituals of power, spells of great strength--those shadowshards maybe very helpful in all kind of arcane magics.

accept.text: Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...$B$BSpeaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.$B$BIf you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!

objectives.text: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

complete.text:
Well done, $c.  Though the extensiveness of the Zukk'ash presence will not be thwarted with anything less than a full-scale invasion, you have bought us some time so we can devise a proper strategy.

I will be sure to have these carapaces analyzed; we'll need to learn everything about them before we deal with what has unfortunately turned into a much larger issue than we had anticipated.

progress.text: How goes the hunt, $N?  Are you here to report your success?

complete.text:
Impressive, $c... most impressive!  If Stinglasher is indeed one of their strongest creatures, the study of the beast will prove to be quite valuable in time.  It's now my charge to make sure we defend ourselves long enough to take advantage of it.

Please accept this coin bounty as a token of the entire camp's thanks, $N.  Well done.

progress.text: Have you managed to bring down Stinglasher yet?

complete.text:
Ah, I've been expecting this.  These creatures you faced... they are an ancient threat that the Horde continues to choose to ignore.  Hadoken was wise to bring this - and you - to me.

The Zukk'ash are nothing more than creatures called the silithid.  Some would think that they are a mindless nuisance, but let me assure you - they are a far, far worse threat than anything the Alliance could muster.

If you're willing and strong enough, I could use your aid in bringing this threat to light.

progress.text: Greetings friend... you look as though you are on urgent business.  Is there something I can help you with?

objectives.text: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

progress.text:
We at the Darkmoon Faire do much walking.  We walk from one faire site to another... in fact, you'll never see us sitting down on the job!  So it is no surprise that we wear out quite a lot of boots!  We need boots that are both durable and stylish, and embossed leather boots fit that bill rather well.

You!  You're a leatherworker; make me embossed leather boots and I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for the work.

accept.text: As you no doubt have heard, the League of Arathor is sending large numbers of troops into Arathi Basin.  Eager for food and supplies, these Alliance fools are intent to take and control the rich resources there.  We must show them that Arathi will never again be a home for humans!$B$BGo to Arathi Basin and assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the stables.  Pull down the enemies' banners, declaring those territories for the Horde.$B$BGo, $n.  Report back to me when this task is complete.

objectives.text: Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.

accept.text: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor.  I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.$B$BUntil...$B$BThose cursed sea giants ruined me!  They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay.  And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest.  He said he wanted it for a snuffbox.  The nerve!$B$BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here.  Find him and get back my chest!  Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.

objectives.text: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

complete.text:
Thanks to your donations, the library is thriving.

Please, take this.

accept.text:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.

complete.text:
Now there's a feather for your cap! Nicely done, $N.

You can rest here for a while, if you like. I'm sure your trek through the desert was arduous.

objectives.text: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.

progress.text: How goes the hunt? Surely the bird hasn't got you beat!

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

accept.text:
A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.

With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.

complete.text:
For a man as proud as Grant Valor to be brought low by such a simple creature says less about him and more about the horrors of battle. It only takes one slip to be crippled for life.

These weapons tell a great deal about their owner. Let me take some time to study them.

objectives.text: Find Grant's Mace on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery then return to Sirra Von'Indie in Darkshire for more information.

progress.text: You wanted to see me?

accept.text:
The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter.

Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.

complete.text: You have recipe? Skonk listening.

objectives.text: Find an ogre who can read the Illegible Recipe.

progress.text: Who you? Maybe Skonk first customer?

accept.text:
Other ogres laugh at Skonk because Skonk smaller than them. They say small ogre weak, so Skonk learn to cook instead of fight. This only cause more teasing, so Skonk run away to follow dream.

Skonk can make dish, but need ingredients. You take note. Find ingredients. Skonk more focused on craft; not really logistics guy.

complete.text: Good work, $r buddy. We really cooking now!

objectives.text: Gather the ingredients for Skonk's dish, then bring them to him in Arathi Highlands

progress.text: You find ingredients yet? Almost dinner time.

accept.text:
Ok $r buddy, it time for Skonk favorite part. Skonk have fire hot and ready, and want to share new dish with new friend. You do such big favors for Skonk; it only right you get some too!

Let Skonk know when you ready for tasting.

complete.text:
Mmm, recipe is delicious!

Skonk get a bit lost in passion of moment, but you were good helper! 

Here, this your share. Skonk even add little something extra for your trouble.

objectives.text: Taste test the recipe with Skonk.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

accept.text:
Your progress in the arcane arts has been exemplary, $n. I think you are ready to author a spellbook of your own.

Let's see... a quill from the Owlbeasts of the Hinterlands, and ink derived from silithid resin... yes, that will do. And for the pages, the finest Farraki Papyrus!

objectives.text: Track down and collect the spellbook materials requested by the librarian.

accept.text:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.

complete.text:
Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.

I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.

progress.text: Welcome to my fire, traveler.

accept.text:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.

complete.text:
Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, $c.

objectives.text: Heal $1oa Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.

accept.text:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

complete.text:
Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.

I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, $N.

objectives.text: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.

accept.text:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

complete.text:
Welcome aboard, $c. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, $c.

objectives.text: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.

accept.text:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?

objectives.text: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

accept.text:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?

complete.text: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!

objectives.text: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.

progress.text: Did you find the supplies?

accept.text: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?

objectives.text: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.

accept.text:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.

Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?

complete.text: You look a bit damp, $N. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.

objectives.text: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.

progress.text: Did you find the supplies?

accept.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>

complete.text:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?

objectives.text: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.

accept.text: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.

complete.text:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?

objectives.text: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.

progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!

accept.text: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

complete.text: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.

objectives.text: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

accept.text:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.

complete.text:
Thank you for returning these stolen books, $N. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.

You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!

objectives.text: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.

progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?

accept.text:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.

complete.text: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.

objectives.text: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

accept.text:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

complete.text:
What's this, $N? Tracking kobolds?

Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.

Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.

objectives.text: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.

progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?

accept.text:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!

complete.text:
I applaud your diligence, $N. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine.

You can keep that book bag!

objectives.text: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.

progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?

accept.text:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.

objectives.text: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.

progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.

progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

accept.text:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!

complete.text:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.

objectives.text: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.

accept.text:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.

complete.text:
Gale's greetings, $N. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history.

Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition.

As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.

objectives.text: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.

complete.text:
Thank you for your service to Zephras, young $c.

The vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.

objectives.text: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.

complete.text: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.

objectives.text: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.

progress.text: Such pests cannot be allowed to find root in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.

accept.text:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.

complete.text: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.

objectives.text: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.

complete.text: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.

objectives.text: Speak to Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?

complete.text: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.

objectives.text: Slay $2oa Roiling Winds and $1oa Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.

complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.

objectives.text: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.

objectives.text: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.

complete.text:
Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.

So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?

objectives.text: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.

complete.text: Well done, $c. The Rangers of the Grove are in your debt.

objectives.text: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.

progress.text: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?

accept.text:
Well hello there, $n! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!

complete.text:
How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our skyborne gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.

objectives.text: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.

accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

complete.text:
Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled $c can give 'em. Good luck.

objectives.text: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.

progress.text:
Ah, ye got me letter, $N... good.

Time was when ye'd not catch a $r dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.

accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.

complete.text:
The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we druids are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the feather, and the branch. 

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

objectives.text: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.

progress.text: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.

complete.text:
Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.

accept.text:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.

complete.text: I didn't say it wouldn't be a dirty job, did I?

objectives.text: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.

progress.text: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... and while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.

accept.text: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

objectives.text: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.

complete.text:
No broken bottles? Yes, you certainly are a better choice for this than Jorell's lackeys.

We'll be able to use these to manage the ills of our patients a while longer.

Since you've proved that you are a natural to field work, I understand injuries come with the territory. Have your choice of the supplies, at least you'll make use of them.

objectives.text: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.

progress.text: If you can get them something for the pain, you can have some of these patients back out the door as fast as they walk in.

accept.text:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.

objectives.text: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.

accept.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Small Eggs and $2oa Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

complete.text:
Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.

You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.

objectives.text: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.

complete.text:
<Blaise lets out a gurgling laugh; the sound coming from his neck. He puts Namida's hoof into his bag before scribbling a new line beneath his first message to you.>

Serves her right!

progress.text: <Blaise points insistently at the note he gave you.>

accept.text:
<You approach the strange crystal, guarded mere moments ago by emaciated mana elementals.

Its pedestal, though ancient, is noticeably less dilapidated than the elven ruins it is built upon.

A weak hum of power radiates from the fractured gemstone, but with its magic so heavily depleted its purpose will ultimately remain a mystery for the time being.

Perhaps there is more to discover nearby.>

complete.text:
To hear that the crystal within the temple shines brightly is an immense weight off my shoulders. I was worried that the centaur had breached the temple grounds now, too. It would seem they continue to be off-put by what's inside.

As for the other pylons, if elementals are still standing vigilant over them, then they are quite capable of being restored.

I hope the temple's denizens didn't frighten you. They are friendly enough, just bitter. Understandably bitter.

objectives.text: Explore Shen'dralas in an effort to find other pylons like the one you found.

accept.text:
You will have to forgive me for sending you on such a series of tasks without providing any context. I hadn't considered how suspicious this may have seemed, more so now that the skies have taken on such a dramatic appearance.

I will gladly answer your questions.

complete.text:
I hope that explanation alleviated any concerns you might have had, $N. As you see, I was not acting out of any foul intent, and my failure to explain the situation thoroughly from the start was purely due to my enthusiasm of having a chance to see the crystals' lights shine again.

I am excited to visit the temple of Shen'dralas again, though it may take some time before I muster the courage to speak with the Shen'dralar there.

You, on the other hand...

objectives.text: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.

accept.text:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, $n. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.

complete.text:
Behold, the Valley of Bones. Forever cursed, a place where not even the great Theradras would smile upon. No clan had dared to step hoof in this place for generations, yet now the Magram seem to have claimed it as their own!

I am poorly trained and unequipped for combat--these arches are the farthest I will go. You, $N, must fight on behalf of the Gelkis.

You have done much for us, but your work has only begun.

objectives.text: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.

accept.text:
You need not peer far to see the undead shambling about ahead of us, but have you noticed something unusual about them?

They walk on two legs, not four! These skeletons are not even our fallen kin. The Magram must be defiling the bodies of those who died long before the Desolace was our domain. I cannot imagine how they justified turning their backs on Mother Theradras and took to desecrating corpses that have rested here for centuries.

Put the undead to rest, $n.

complete.text:
You looked battered and beaten, but not broken. Your efforts have made a difference to those that have been put back to rest, but I am sure you have noticed the turmoil in the valley has only risen.

I fear it won't be long before those same bones you buried are back on their feet.

We must press on.

objectives.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay $1oa Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.

accept.text:
While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.

I cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.

$n, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.

complete.text:
<Nerlokh swiftly takes the cloth and accessories from you and his expression grows cold. After observing only a few from the collection, he sets the rest aside.>

$N. These lesser necromancers are Gelkis.

I see now why our clan seems to be losing numbers more frequently than our skirmishes would indicate. Some among us are defecting, presumably in effort to impress the Magram.

Our clan is losing this war.

objectives.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring $1oa Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.

progress.text:
You have my word that I will share my suspicion with you once you have completed the task.

For the sake of our clan, let us hope my eyes were playing tricks on me.

accept.text:
This discovery is devastating for our clan, but it is in our best interest to keep this only to those who need to know. Uthek is one such person who needs to be aware of what is going on here. I suspect she will know how to proceed.

Take this to show her. For good measure, we should also bring evidence of the necromancy itself to her. Find a skull that looks recently cursed. I suspect they may be hoarding them in the maws of one of the goliath's skeletons.

complete.text:
<Uthek listened to your explanation with an expression of doubt, until you presented the material evidence.>

I noticed our dwindling numbers, $N, but never would I have expected this! Necromancy... shamelessly wielded by those foul Magram. Now I learn that my clan is involved too?

<Uthek spits, only narrowly away from your direction.>

I will speak with the Khan. For now, you will prepare to return to the front lines.

objectives.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

progress.text: I did not expect to see you back so soon. Is this a bad omen?

accept.text:
When you return to Nerlokh in the Valley of Bones, it will not be empty-handed.

Go inside the cave at the heart of our village and seek out Mulara. Ask for Tears of Theradras on my behalf. Our supply is low, but it is our best hope against the Magram's foul necromancy!

I will prepare a ritual. We will create a weapon to disrupt their spells.

objectives.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring Tears of Theradras back to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

complete.text:
These are simply delightful! Look at the forelegs on this one! The coloring of this one's carapace! Oh, and this one's mandibles!

I didn't take you for an entomologist, but you have quite a keen eye.

Please, take this. I think he might have taken a liking to you, and I've already catalogued this particular species.

Now, if you'll excuse me, I must return to my research. You've given me much to study!

progress.text:
I must say, though, there's nothing like the thrill of finding new specimens. I used to delight in scrounging for them through all manner of muck and grime, but I rarely get the opportunity these days.

In that sense, my little brood is both a blessing and a curse. Because they require so much attention, I cannot travel beyond the swamp.

accept.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.

objectives.text: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?

objectives.text: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
As the garden's caretaker, it was my responsibility to ensure it thrived.

I knew there would come a day when I could no longer maintain it, so I enchanted a necklace gifted from my daughter to transform a new generation of saplings into treants, so they could watch over the garden in my stead. I placed it on an enchanted pedestal, sheltered within a small shrine.

The garden was in great hands. I must know what happened.

complete.text:
<Mithera listens quietly to your explanation of the situation.>

The pedestal is empty? My necklace is... missing?

<A great sadness washes over her expression.>

I should have expected as much. The quilboar and the centaur have been ravaging these lands for such a short amount of time, but the damage they have already done is immeasurable.

$N, even if the magic is gone from the necklace, I am clinging onto hope that I may have it back. Would you be willing to help?

objectives.text: Investigate the Forlorn Gardens near Shen'dralas and then return to Mithera at the nearby temple.

accept.text:
Please spare the details of how the life may have been twisted there. My heart is broken enough with the loss of my necklace.

But while I weep, the plants suffer.

$n, I would like you to go back to the garden and cull some of the angered flora. Please be swift and merciful; they can feel pain, and they have been hurt enough. If you intend to go hunting for my necklace as well, I would ask you to prioritize that before visiting the gardens again... in the unlikely chance you find it.

objectives.text: Cull plants in the Forlorn Garden and then return to Mithera at Shen'dralas.

accept.text:
I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good!

The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble.
