With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.

objectives.text: Locate Magister Kirandis inside the temple of Shen'dralas.

accept.text:
I am the ancient. Towering above us. That which still burns despite many rains. I feel its flames in death. Forever burdened by my last mistake.

I do not know why I am cursed to haunt this place. I do not understand why death was not the end.

Please put out the flame. Seek pristine water from a sacred ravine. Such a place exists across Mashan'she. I have heard murmurs of the place in the wind.

Maraudon.

complete.text:
<The flames that previously burned away at the treant's ghostly form have faded. Still, his gaze is hollow. It takes several moments of inaction before he regards your presence.>

My torment has ended. Peace approaches me.

No time for farewells. No time to wait for those that have forgotten me.

Traveler, I have one final thing to say. One last hope for your quest.

objectives.text: Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial of Earth Song Water and return it to Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens in Desolace.

progress.text: <Woodwyrd stands, nearly motionless. He stares through you, just as you once might have stared through the ghosts of Shen'dralas.>

accept.text:
Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.

There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.

Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?

complete.text: Thank you for keeping The Harborage safe, and keeping the blood of our kin from our hands.

objectives.text: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.

accept.text:
Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!

I was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.

Well, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, $r!

complete.text: That's the one! Oh, thank you, $r. Come back sometime and I'll give you a share of my catch!

objectives.text: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.

progress.text: I can't catch a thing without my lucky lure! We may well starve out here.

accept.text:
Allow me to admit something, $n. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.

I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands. 

At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.

I ask that you find this mage, $r. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.

complete.text: Draenethyst, you say? Yes, I may know a thing or two about that...

objectives.text: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.

accept.text:
I suppose it would be more accurate to say I know someone who knows a thing or two about draenethyst.

You see, the warlocks of the Burning Blade have been studying it. It is a substance from beyond the dark portal, so it follows that those involved with darker arts might wish to harness it to their own ends. We cannot allow this, obviously.

The specific warlock you seek is named Gimashi. She can be found atop her tower, which is in a ravine to the southeast. Her notes will have the answers you seek.

objectives.text: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.

accept.text:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?

complete.text:
Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade. 

Windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.

objectives.text: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.

progress.text: Hello there, $c.

accept.text:
<With a terrible crunch, you removed a piece of the worm's carapace upon its demise.

Despite its enormous size and hefty weight, it is disappointingly ordinary. This creature was seemingly not the result of a cruel experiment nor carefully bred to be an all-devouring beast.

It is simply an impressive shell, likely desired only by collectors. Perhaps you could find one, though other than the centaur, who else might be alive around here?>

complete.text:
<The quilboar's eyes dart over toward the carapace jutting out from your backpack. He snorts once. Twice. Three times even, before pulling his blade away.>

Big Worm dead?

Big Worm dig through Bristleback land. Eat our dead. Devour our young.

Big worm dead. Big $R hero of Bristleback. Big $R allowed in quilboar land. For now.

What Big $R want?

objectives.text: Find someone interested in Corpsefeeder's Carapace.

progress.text: <Kog'thug has a blade to your throat before you manage to say a word.>

accept.text:
Among the treants borne of the necklace, one in particular stood above all the others to have received the gift of life and sentience. I suspect if they have fallen, he may be the only one that remains.

He spent his days tending to each and every bloom and bud, and his evenings rooted in the ground to serve as a nest for the smaller critters.

If he is alive, and I pray that to be true, then he may know what happened.

I am holding out hope for my good friend, Woodwyrd.

complete.text:
It is too late. For these gardens.

I am the last of my generation of caretakers. Without the gift, more cannot take my place.

The weeds have overtaken the land. The flowers are restless. The trees wither.

<Woodwyrd slowly turns toward the towering ancient illuminating the sky with its endless fire.>

objectives.text: Find Woodwyrd in the Forlorn Gardens at Shen'dralas in the Desolace.

accept.text:
If you wish to recover the woman's gift, march north into the Valley of Bones.

It was stolen. The quilboar are to blame. I saw it. With my own two eyebulbs.

They are why this garden is doomed to die.

Do not forgive them.

complete.text:
Big $R want necklace? Well, Big $R can't have!

Thornweavers need necklace. Land is deader than dead. Thorns no sprout without necklace! Centaur tread where thorns no sprout. See problem, or Big $R blind?

<Kog'thug pauses his condescending ramble and snorts thoughtfully.>

Kog'thug have idea. Want trade?

objectives.text: Seek out a quilboar of significance at the Bristleback Retreat.

accept.text:
Big $R heard of Razorfen Downs? <Snort.> Of course not! Big place in Barrens. Lots of thorns. Can't miss it.

Agamaggan died there. Important place for all quilboar. Now bristleback not allowed. Belong to sniffle-snorting Razorfen. Razorfen disrespect quilboar history!

Agamaggan's blood feeds the valley. Grow thorns. BIG ones. Bigger than puny elf necklace ever could!

Go to the Downs. Fetch Kog'thug blood. Stale blood from the kraul won't work. Need GOOD blood!

Give blood, get necklace, win.

objectives.text: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.

accept.text:
<Found near Shen'dralas, this dirty old tome no longer holds most of its knowledge.

Of the text that remains, individual letters are difficult to distinguish from words. It may prove challenging to read at first, but one of them appears to be a surname.

Perhaps its author, "Evenshade", may be found nearby.>

complete.text:
My journal? Certainly not, it was lost centuries ago.

<Mordent reclaims the dirty tome and examines the cover. His brow lifts in surprise, but it falls after he opens the covers.>

You have indeed found my journal, but alas, all that I had written is gone. I have not forgotten what was within, but I do not wish to speak any of it aloud.

Should its pages have also survived somehow, you have my permission to attempt to restore it.

objectives.text: The text suggests the author of this journal may be somewhere in Shen'dralas.

progress.text: Is there something you need?

accept.text:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.

objectives.text: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.

accept.text:
Does your blade thirst for human blood, $n?

Some years ago, the human defectors laid claim to a small farm to the southwest across the river. With the area rich in lumber and stone, it was only a matter of time before they expanded their reach to the keep along the eastern shore known as Farholde.

Our first skirmishes would have ended in our favor if we'd had the numbers. It's time to remind them of our presence.

Disrupt their farming efforts. Take no prisoners. Send them a clear message.

complete.text: Hmph. I can smell their blood upon you.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Meadowsbrook Farmhands, then return to Krom'rosh with news of your success.

accept.text:
Humans within these lands have long enjoyed the warmth, comfort and sustenance these lands provide. It's time we start denying these humans such pleasantries.

Seek out the supplies of our enemies at the farm to the southwest. Take whatever you find.

It won't bring pleasure like bloodying a blade, but slowing them buys us time to plan our next move.

complete.text:
Smells of earth and root, yes? Not pleasant, but we do what we must to survive.

Throwing this into a boiling cauldron with fish and wild grass makes the pains of hunger retreat like cowardly human dogs.

objectives.text: Steal $1oa Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook then return to Krom'rosh.

progress.text: Returned with our supplies?

accept.text:
With the human presence to the south and Twilight to the west, the battle for resources has become difficult. But why gather resources amongst our enemies when their blades will suffice?

Follow the river south to the mill. When you hear the whistling of woodworkers among the trees, tread lightly. When the opportunity presents itself, strike hard and fast.

I'll stay behind to keep the forge running hot. Gur'dok will break down the blades while I fashion weaponry forged of their own materials.

complete.text:
The blood on these blades is still fresh. Impressive.

How long do you think it will take for the humans to realize we've been using their own weapons against them?

objectives.text: Retrieve $1oa Woodworker's Axe from the lumberjacks at Turner's Logging Camp for Kreza Darkthorn in Rog'mar.

progress.text: Have you retrieved what we discussed?

accept.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.

objectives.text: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
While Gur'dok and I continue our work, we did fashion a particular blade for a friend--perhaps friend is too strong a word--for an acquaintance down at the docks. This particular individual is well known and connected all across the Kingdoms and beyond.

Take this. When you deliver it, let her know I sent you. And tell her we're even.

complete.text:
Hey there! Nice to meet ya!

Did Kreza really say we're even? That's cute.

objectives.text: Deliver the blade to Kreza Darkthorn's acquaintance at the docks east of Rog'mar.

progress.text: A delivery on behalf of the horde, eh? You must be with Kreza.

accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Silver Skeleton Key, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

objectives.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Practice Lock, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

objectives.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

complete.text:
My new home is surrounded by turtles, yet I have no knowledge of how to properly prepare their meat nor craft equipment with their scales.

As shameful as it feels, my survival has depended upon the aid of others outside my tribe. I have been humbled by the kindness of strangers, and humbled by the simple yet effective techniques they have taught me.

I hope to learn from this turtle scale breastplate in much the same way.

progress.text: <The $r woman acknowledges you with a glare, but allows you to approach nonetheless.>

accept.text:
Greetings, young $n. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.

complete.text: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.

objectives.text: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.

accept.text:
The humans of these lands are only one of many threats. With the encroaching Twilight and snarls of gnolls echoing from the hills nearby, battle may call at a moment's notice. Maintaining the strength of our allies may be the difference between Rog'mar's success or our removal from these lands.

Deliver the goods you've gathered to Gorg. He'll make sure our allies are well fed.

complete.text:
Pungent. Earthy. And something a bit unpleasant. It appears you've been ransacking the farmstead, $N.

This will make for a hearty stew in no time.

objectives.text: Deliver the Stolen Feed to Gorg in Rog'mar.

accept.text:
This hearty stew keeps our trainees fed, enough so that our enemies remain at a distance.

Bring this and feed our trainees to the west. Don't listen to any complaints. With how difficult defending our supply lines has become, they should be so lucky we're not feeding them dirt.

complete.text:
Any more complaints and they can bring them to me directly.

I am thankful for your work in retrieving this food, as are our warriors, despite what they say.

objectives.text: Feed $1oa Rog'mar Trainees at the training grounds.

accept.text:
Our scouts have reported training camps by the river to the south. If I'd received word sooner, it would have saved us both the hassle of locating and removing the human filth in a timely manner.

Continue your efforts, $n. Holding back the humans to their precious little keep will buy us time to focus on other matters at hand.

Be swift about it.

complete.text: Swift work. Now let's continue our momentum elsewhere.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Farholde Priests and $2oa Farholde Scouts south of the river.

accept.text:
Though the gnoll presence has dwindled with the Twilight's encroachment, the threat remains.

The hills to the southwest are infested with their kind, disrupting trades and travelers alike.

Clear a path for our allies by removing the threat.

complete.text: The scent of gnolls is not one that washes away easily.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

accept.text:
Among the cackling inhabitants of the Bristle Hills southwest of here is an elder gnoll by the name of Snargl. The sounds emanating from this particular gnoll are quite unpleasant. Their presence inspires those around, creating a problem for allies and scouts who enter the area.

A trophy as a memento of our having dealt with this most unpleasant gnoll fiend would fit nicely with my collection.

Be swift about it, $n.

complete.text: Heavier than I expected, but a wonderful addition no less.

objectives.text: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and retrieve his snout for Neza Bloodsnout.

progress.text: Found my new trophy yet?

accept.text:
Our allies mining ore from the hills to the south reported several attacks by gnolls in the area.

Travel south, locate their camps and retrieve the stolen ore. Take it from their dead bodies if need be.

complete.text: You've done well, $N. The scorching heat from our flame will remove any markings or scent that remains.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Stolen Ore from gnolls in the Bristle Hills for Kreza Darkthorn.

progress.text: Have you located the stolen ore?

complete.text:
Jom-jom saved by little one, hmm?

Little one is friend.

Hey, hey! Look what we got here. Another victim...er entrant lookin' to prove themselves at the precipice of power!

Well step right up, bub. Today's your lucky day... or not.
A very wise choice.

progress.text: So, what'll it be?

accept.text:
The battle of the Bloodmaster's Ring begins!

We'll start you off easy here, pal. This flighty fiend'll take you down, then pick ya clean.

Now quit standin' around and step into the ring. Fame awaits!

complete.text: See? What'd I tell ya. Ain't nothin' to worry about here.

objectives.text: Defeat Buzzbeak in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

complete.text: Excellent work, $N. With their numbers diminished, we can seek the source of the Twilight Hammer's unprecedented expansion.

These missives tell of disturbing news, $N. These are no mere stragglers aimlessly biting at our heels like rabid animals. The Twilight's Hammer is here for a reason. They are searching for something.

progress.text: Slay the Twilight Shadowmancers and search their corpses. With luck, they will have the information we seek.

complete.text: Ouch! Ouch! No more hit! What you want?

Goblin sent you? Me no like little goblin. He talk too much.

But me help Chub'chob. He good friend.

You make good work.

Berry smell yum yum good.

progress.text: You get food?

complete.text:
He said that? About me? Eh, no matter.

It's time we focus on what's really important--keepin' ol' Snufflesnout happy, and by Snufflesnout, I mean Chub'chob.
Hey, hey. Quiet down. I get the excitement, but that ain't no reason to rub it in.

accept.text:
You did well slowing the Twilight's Hammer. Their foothold in Sunnyglade has weakened and you've turned their ogre warriors against them. Now we take the fight to them.

My brother, Dag'rosh, has already gone ahead with a scouting party. I would have preferred he waited for you, but he is impulsive and overeager--like a true warrior. I'd be honored if you joined him in battle at their stronghold to the west.

complete.text:
Krom'rosh sent you? He's more overbearing than a milk-toothed swineherd.

Not that I'll deny the extra muscle.

objectives.text: Find Da'grosh in the hills west of Rog'mar.

accept.text:
Do you see the fortress just west of here? The Twilight's Shroud, they call it. Filled to the brim with Twilight's Hammer cowards.

They may have walls and numbers, but their pitiful reliance on devilry and ancient gods makes them weak. Show them how vulnerable they really are!

complete.text: Listen to them scream for their gods with no answer. The only true strength is within one's own hands!

objectives.text: Defeat $1oa Twilight Fanatics, $2oa Twilight Corrupters, and $3oa Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh.

accept.text:
Those Twilight's Hammer dogs caught us before we could properly begin our attack. I was able to fight my way out, but my warriors were not so lucky. They were dragged off by the cult's champions and imprisoned in the fortress to the west.

Orcs do not belong in cages, $c. Free my brothers and sisters, and we will show these mongrels a real fight.

complete.text:
Good work, $c. 

My warriors are in no condition to fight and have returned to Rog'mar. But you and I are not done here yet.

objectives.text: Rescue $1oa Rog'mar Scouts within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh.

accept.text:
Tran'gul's notes pointed to a leader of this Twilight's Hammer presence somewhere in that fortress. With my warriors free and the cult's numbers in disarray, now is the time to pierce the heart of this infestation.

Return to the Twilight's Shroud and enter their Stronghold. That is where you will find Overlord Kilgar. That is where we will exact our revenge.

complete.text:
I would have loved to see the look on Kilgar's face when you showed him just how exposed he truly was.

And now I can.

<Da'grosh laughs as he tosses Kilgar's head into the dirt.>

objectives.text: Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Da'grosh.

progress.text: The coward is sure to be hiding deep within his stronghold. Bring me his head that we may put an end to this blight.

accept.text:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.

objectives.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.

complete.text:
Where did you say you found this? I'm surprised you're still fully intact. Thanks, kid.

Y'know. If you're in the habit of doin' favors, I bet plenty of folk 'round here will have a use for ya. Why don'tcha stick around for a bit?

accept.text:
<The gnoll pulls a bit of gold from his pocket and waves it at you.>

$R, I offer trade! There is more where this came from. Help me get revenge, and I will show you!

complete.text: Yes yes, very good! Now we get out of here and go to treasure.

objectives.text: Bring 20 Twilight Finger Bones to Fuzzle.

progress.text: Bring me fingers, *then* I show you treasure.

accept.text:
Alright, so you got a few wins under your belt. So what?

You're a long way from becoming the champ, bub. But I tell ya what--I'll make sure this next battle ain't one you'll soon forget.

Hope you're ready for a surprise.

complete.text:
You sure ain't makin' me look good, pal. But I guess that doesn't matter much since our ogre friends here seem to be well entertained.

Don't let it go to your head.

objectives.text: Defeat Bonegnaw in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
Come, $r. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds!

Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward.

complete.text: <It seems Fuzzle had amassed a hefty sum of gold, at least by gnoll standards. Looks like it's yours now.>

objectives.text: <Fuzzle snarls.>

accept.text:
Let's see if we can keep this crowd's excitement goin'.

This next contender ain't no joke.

Best of luck to ya! See you soon, maybe.

complete.text:
Alright, big shot. Where the heck did you say you was from again?

You're startin' to make me look bad here.

objectives.text: Defeat Mog'thar in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
Alright, so I'll place the treat and then you enter the ring and prepare for what's comin'.

What? Why you lookin' at me like that? I said we're gonna feed her. What I may have forgotten to mention was that ol' Snufflesnout gets pretty riled up at the sight of her favorite treat.

You're in a bit of a sticky situation here, bub. Proving yourself to our ogre friends is of the utmost importance, but boy oh boy would I be nervous inflicting harm to Chubchob's precious companion.

Well, off ya go!

complete.text: If I was you I'd watch yer step around here. You may have made a bit of a mess by defeating Chub'chob's friend.

objectives.text: Defeat Snufflesnout in the Bloodmaster's Ring.

accept.text:
Of the few that managed to infiltrate the cave, most have perished. It seems these Twilight have a foothold much larger than we thought. We will not stand by while these cultists continue to ravage these lands and make sacrifices of our allies. We end this now, $n.

Infiltrate this stronghold, slaughter their forces and bring me proof of their leader's demise.

complete.text:
Let this serve as our message.

Lok'tar!

objectives.text: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Krom'rosh with proof of their leader's demise.

progress.text: Has the leader been located?

accept.text:
With their location revealed, it is likely that within this stronghold are secrets kept well hidden from those we have encountered thus far. It would be wise for us to locate and recover any information that may be of use to our fight against these cultists.

See what you can uncover, $n. I await your return.

complete.text:
As I suspected, magic bindings and a shadow cipher. It will take time to unlock the secrets within.

Nevertheless, your work has been of great help, $N. I will begin my work at once.

objectives.text: Recover the Tome of Twilight from Krol'dok Stronghold.

progress.text: Find anything of interest?

accept.text: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>

complete.text: A curious find, $N. If this is from the stronghold it must be important.

objectives.text: Find someone in Rog'mar who may know about the mould.

accept.text:
The moulding is crude and worn, but we may be able to fashion a key.

It may take some time to gather the components necessary. I'll keep these embers running hot while you gather the materials.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Thick Leather and $2oa Iron Bar to Kreza Darkthorn.

progress.text: Do you have the materials?

accept.text:
Our work here is not finished, $n. These cultists have inflicted unimaginable pain upon our allies and rendered these lands for their taking.

We will not tolerate these actions any longer.

To the north lies a hidden cave network, masked by the rugged terrain. Our scouts spoke of cultist movement under the veil of darkness.

Seek out this cave and find where these cultists are hiding. It's time we deliver a message they won't soon forget.

complete.text: A gift from our enemies, bestowed upon you.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Cultist Ears from the Twilight's Hammer in Krol'dok Stronghold.

progress.text: Vengeance is best born of blood.

accept.text:
If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too.

If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.

complete.text:
Heh, ol' Tan'jani sent ya? Good for him.

We're always looking for an extra hand.

objectives.text: Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

complete.text: Now that we've got the materials we need, we just need a smith to craft the blade for us. I think I know just such a smith.

progress.text: Trust in the light to guide your blade. However, the light needs a good blade to guide.

accept.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...

objectives.text: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.

accept.text:
Time for a special delivery.

Old Krom'rosh is waiting for this package over at Rog'mar just west of here.

I suggest you get it to him quickly, but carefully. Why, you might ask? It's better to not ask questions.

complete.text:
We've forged many relationships out of respect, others out of necessity.

These dealings help us accomplish our goals.

objectives.text: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.

accept.text:
Ok, listen up. You've showed quite a bit of prowess in the ring. You've managed to upset Chub'chob more than words can explain. Sure glad I ain't you right now.

Just in case you was wonderin', I should remind you that your entry fee does not cover accidental death.

It's been great knowin' ya, but you're on your own from here on out, bub.

Best of luck to ya.

complete.text:
Tiny thing show power in arena. Bring cheers from ogres.

Victory brings new friend to clan. You fight and feast with ogres now.

objectives.text: Defeat Chub'chob, Bloodmaster of Bolder'ok, in the Bloodmaster's Ring, then share the news of becoming the newly crowned champion of the Bloodmaster's Ring with Clugfist at Bolder'ok.

accept.text:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.

complete.text:
Interesting. I don't think anyone has ever asked me to actually carry out a custom commission for them. Mostly I just make humble, functional weapons in my own style. It's not much, but it's honest work and I don't seek accolades or glory.

I'm happy to try, but why would you seek me for this? There are plenty of smiths in the Undercity that will take on custom jobs like this.

objectives.text: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.

progress.text: Are you in need of a blade, $c?

accept.text:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.

complete.text: You handled 'em? Good! I'm sure more'll be back soon, but at least I can get some peace and quiet until then.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.

accept.text:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.

complete.text: Nicely done, $r. Now, we go for the bigger fish.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Eastsea Buccaneers and $2oa Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.

A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.

complete.text: Well, that's one less thing to worry about around here, I certainly owe ya for that. Here, don't spend it all in one place.

objectives.text: Bring proof of Old Rot-Chum's demise to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.

progress.text: I got a lot on my plate, $r, make it quick.
I got a lot on my plate, skyborne, make it quick.

accept.text:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!

objectives.text: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.

progress.text: The trick to murloc eyes is you gotta cook 'em real quick. That way, you can still taste the brine!

complete.text:
I see you're not afraid to get your hands dirty. I like that.

Thanks to you, things are shaping up for us to put those scallywags down for good.

<Whizzbuzz lets out a surprised whistle.>

Whew, these are huge! Can't wait to light these puppies up and send those pirates sky-high!

progress.text: Got that gunpowder yet?

complete.text:
I'll be honest, I wasn't sure you'd survive a tangle with Lamora. Guess you're the real deal!

If you ever need a favor you can call on ol' Whizzbuzz. Heck, I might call on you for one too if I need it!

<Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz gives you a wink and a crooked grin.>

progress.text: Killing Lamora is about getting even. Stealing back his loot is about breaking even.

accept.text:
These are some truly fine materials, $c. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.

complete.text:
This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity.

Aka'Magosh, friend.

objectives.text: Watch as Ott forges your blade.

accept.text: Here's the blade. You said that a paladin named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.

complete.text:
<Trevan takes the blade and inspects it carefully.> 

This will do nicely, $N. I knew that Ott had it in him to make something truly great.

The only thing left now is to kill that beast. Speak with Lumina when you are ready.

objectives.text: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.

progress.text: Was Ott able to carry out the commission?

accept.text:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.

complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Banon may now rest in peace.

If you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people.

<Lumina Windsinger's eyes begin to glow a vibrant blue as she touches the bloodstained blade in your hand.>

It is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, $c.

objectives.text: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.

progress.text: Is it done? Is the beast slain?

accept.text:
Far to the northeast beyond Stonard lies an embattled land along the eastern coast known as the Riverglades.

Many have sought to lay claim to these lands, but few have succeeded. There is one, however, whose experience battling our enemies proved enough to settle a small outpost known as Rog'mar. Through countless attacks, it still remains.

As ruthless as Krom'rosh may be, his will has served our allies greatly. If it's battle you seek, head northeast to seek out this old friend of ours.

complete.text:
Aggro'gosh sent you? I respect his willingness to support our efforts, though his concerns are his alone.

We will defeat the humans AND the Twilight's Hammer. If it's battle you seek, there are plenty of ways to engage your services in the name of the Horde.

objectives.text: Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades.

accept.text:
I've been watching you, $n. You handle yourself well out here. Perhaps you'd be interested in helping me locate my brother, Tan'jani.

He was always searching for something--for what I do not know. I received two messages since he left. The first from another traveler, letting me know he'd run into Tan'jani somewhere south of Loch Modan. The second was a bloodstained letter mentioning Riverglades and somewhere called Rog'mar, even further south. The rest was illegible.

Think you can locate him for me?

complete.text:
Tor'gan sent ya all de way down here ta find me? He always be lookin' out for me. Hopin' I'll be seein' him sometime soon.

But I don't be leavin' my post till de job's done, yeah? Long history with Krom'rosh. Almost as long as Tor'gan. Almost.

Everything's fine here, mon. Nothin' ta worry bout. 'Cept for them Twilight always bein' up ta no good. Ol' Krom'rosh out by da big fire can tell ya more 'bout that.

objectives.text: Find Tan'jani at Rog'mar in the Riverglades.

progress.text:
Don't bother with the little ones. There's not enough meat on them yet to satisfy an ogre.

Hurry, $c. They're starting to look hungry.

complete.text: That should be the last of them. I'll need to repair the gate, but a swift kick in the rear will convince those little piglets not to go running off again.

progress.text:
You may be wondering: What's a little ol' wharfmaster know about homemade explosives?

Let's just say... I used to make a less honest living.

accept.text:
You want ogre weapon? Me know no. You small. Can't hold good.

You bring Hamur more rocks, me make you tiny weapon. Good for tiny creature.

Find good rocks for good weapon. Hamur has discerning eye. Not just any rock will do. Find rocks near river outside Bolder'ok.

complete.text: These good rocks! Hamur make tiny creature tiny weapon.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Good Rocks for Hamur in Bolder'ok.

progress.text: Not all rocks equal. Some good. Some gooder.

accept.text:
Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz

complete.text: Yanked this right off that thing, huh? Impressive! With a little butter, and a dash of my secret spice blend, we're in for one hell of a meal!

objectives.text: Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.

progress.text: What's the word, $r?

accept.text:
The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be?

The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.

complete.text: Sea monster...? Wait! So you've <hic> seen it too!?

objectives.text: Find someone at Powderfuse Port who can identify the monster from the painted hide.

accept.text:
That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories!

We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait...

Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.

complete.text:
<Argo throws a hand over his mouth in reaction to the smell.>

Ugh...great work skipper. Now <hic> put those away before I get sick again...

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Beast Entrails and $2oa Rotflesh Mushrooms for Argo Brinewhistle.

progress.text: When we catch that thing...oh ho...no one'll be laughing at ol' Argo then!
Is it...is that monster dead yet...?

accept.text:
The threat is greater than we thought. Rog'mar must be warned.

Do not stop for anyone on your path.

complete.text:
As a child, Da'grosh would seek to inspire myself and the other kin of our village that some day we would all become great warriors of the Horde, saving our people from imminent danger.

Now, it appears that opportunity has come.

objectives.text: Deliver the missive to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.

accept.text:
Lok-tar, $n. I find myself in need of assistance with a serious matter. 

Some time ago we dispatched a contingent of Kor'kron Elite to Dustwallow Marsh on a special mission. The problem is, we are far past their scheduled check-in with no word from them.

Head down to Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh and speak with an orc named Nazeer Bloodspike. No one is more knowledgeable about the state of Dustwallow than he. Find out what you can.

complete.text: Eitrigg sent you? What does that old wolf want?

objectives.text: Speak with Nazeer Bloodspike in Brackenwall Village.

accept.text:
A small force of Kor'kron soldiers passed through here a few days ago. Never told me why they were here, and I didn't ask. They bought supplies, took a bit of rest, then moved on.

The Kor'kron are the elite of the elite and tougher than elekk hooves, but I can't help feeling that something went wrong.

I did overhear one of them mention "the island", and there's an island called Alcaz just off the coast. It's a really nasty place. Get some friends and look into what befell these Kor'kron.

complete.text:
Yes... I am Kor'kron. 

And you... $c. You've just been conscripted.

objectives.text: Find the missing Kor'kron Elites.

accept.text:
<Sergeant Ulka struggles to sit up to speak with you. You offer your hand in aid, but she merely swats it away.>

Alright recruit... let's get you caught up.

complete.text: The rest of our mission details are need to know, and that's all you need to know. So, are you ready to do your duty to your warchief?

objectives.text: Speak with Sergeant Ulka to learn more about the situation on Alcaz Isle.

accept.text:
You look like you're in the habit of doing whatever other people tell ya. I like that in a lackey. With a little trainin' you could be a great asset. Let's put that to the test.

Recently some of those Eastsea pirates made off with a shipment of MY stolen goods. That's bad sportsmanship. I stole them first!

Lesson one, lackey. Never backstab a backstabber. Go show them that they messed with the wrong goblin and take back my stuff. With force, preferably.

complete.text:
Looks like you learned your first lesson well, lackey. And I ain't even gonna charge ya for that nugget of wisdom! Am I a great boss or what?

Take some time to reflect on this epiphany then it's off to your next assignment.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Smuggled Goods for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.

progress.text: How's trainin' comin'? It's just slittin' a few throats. I got high hopes for ya, kid.
Yer lucky I don't split ye stem to stern fer steppin' on me ship, landlubber! Give me one reason I shouldn't keelhaul yer right now!

complete.text:
Captain who? Well, whoever he is, it sounds like you two learned my next important lesson.

Don't ever double-cross me.

accept.text:
Ya did good with those pirates, lackey. But here's a lesson for ya you may want to remember. What some may call a pirate, others call a freebooter. And you can't spell freebooter without free booty. And there's no better place for free booty than Booty Bay!

<Friz waits for your reply.>

Keep up with me here, kid. I'm sayin' I need you to go to Booty Bay to meet with my contact. He gets goods from the local pirates there-- err, freebooters. Look, just go find Ruzzgot. He'll explain the rest.

complete.text:
It's not every day we get a visitor from Powderfuse Port. That's no small trek!

I'm guessin' if you came all the way out here on your own you ain't in much caravannin' needs, eh? Who sent you, then? Friz?

objectives.text: Speak to Friz's contact in Booty Bay.

accept.text:
Sounds like you're ready for your next lesson, champ. I got some negotiatin' of my own to do here in town, so I need you to run a few errands for me while I'm busy.

All I need you to do is take the next ship over there by the docks and deliver this crate to my associate in Steamwheedle Port.

Don't gimme that look. It'll be plenty excitin', I'm sure. Gettin' a goblin to pay his dues is much harder than roughin' up the local riffraff, not to mention gettin' through customs. You'll figure it out.

complete.text:
There's no way I'm lettin' you into my town without me checkin' your cargo first.

<The wharfmaster clears his throat deliberately as he maintains eye contact with you.>

No. Way.

objectives.text: Speak with Wharfmaster Steamfizzle at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

progress.text: Shipment from Powderfuse Port, huh? And from Friz no less. Good luck with that, buddy. You gotta wake up pretty early in the mornin' to pull that one over me!

accept.text:
Your orders are simple-- Go into the dungeons beneath the keep and find Commander Folkar. Free him if he lives, and learn what you can about what in the twisting nether is going on here.

There's an army waiting for you down there and you won't survive on your own. I hope you have allies... preferably strong ones.

objectives.text: Enter the Alcaz Prison and find Commander Folkar.

accept.text:
I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan.

Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand $Gboy:girl;, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know.

Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.

complete.text: Welcome, welcome friend! You here to participate in the notorious Gadgetzan Arena?

objectives.text: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.

accept.text:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.

accept.text:
Tazzik sent you to collect his winnings? That's a joke, right? His slackjaw champion didn't even last two minutes in the arena! That loser didn't earn a single copper.

It's none of my business, pal, but if I were you I'd skedaddle back to Steamwheedle Port. While you're standin' here talkin' to me, that little rat Tazzik is probably tryin' to hop the next ship outta here.

complete.text:
Okay you win! I bet everythin' I had on those fights to pay off Friz and I lost it all!

But I can't give back her stuff. You gotta help me out here!

objectives.text: Confront Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

accept.text:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?

complete.text:
Venture Co? And the trunk was empty?

Those rotten cheats stole my money! I knew dealin' with those good-for-nothin' pirates was bad for business! Nobody goes back on a deal with Ruzzgot and gets away with it.

objectives.text: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

accept.text:
I already spent good coin on that crate. We ain't just going to let them have it!

You want your shipment? Go to the Venture Co's camp up north and find out who's responsible for this backstabbin'! This ain't about money anymore, $n. This is about justice! And maybe a little about the money.

objectives.text: Find the Venture Co. Ledger in the Venture Co. Camp near Lake Nezferiti in Stranglethorn.

accept.text:
<Wharfmaster Steamfizzle inspects the coin you offered him.>

Whoa-ho! Ol' Friz sure is training the new generation right. Apologies for the delay, $Gsir:ma'am;. You're here to deliver a crate to someone in town, right? I don't know anythin' about that, but if I did, I'd go talk with Tazzik on the dock. He seems to be interested in things like that.

But be quick about it though, yeah? Don't need folks gettin' the wrong idea, ya know.

complete.text:
Hello beautiful! Friz sure delivers, doesn't she? And look at the quality of these.

What? Hey don't look at me. I didn't tell you to spend all your gold breaking the law. Far as I'm concerned, this shipment's been cleared by customs. Friz's money on the other hand... that might be a problem.

objectives.text: Deliver Friz's Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port.

progress.text: Uck, you don't have to tell me where you're from. I can smell Powderfuse Port all over you.

complete.text: <The ogre lies dead, surrounded by a ring of dark runes. It appears to have been overwhelmed by the powers of the Twilight Hammer's ritual.>

Well, well. Looks like that cave was not our only surprise.

You managed to convince one of the Twilight's Hammer ogres to defect? And he mentioned others of his kind? We must act on this immediately.

progress.text: So, the Twilight's Hammer found something in the earth? You were right to banish this evil, $N. If it interests those fanatics, it's not to be trusted.

complete.text:
You smash Chogg'Zac? Little thing shows power.

What you want with Clugfist?

progress.text:
<The massive ogre belches in your face.>

What tiny creature bring Clugfist?

accept.text:
Here ogres value strength and blood.

Weak ones leave Bolder'ok. Go back to Twilight's Hammer.

You no big. Maybe you strong. Show Clugfist strength and smash weak ogres. If tiny creature can.

complete.text: Tiny $r show strength. Ground shook with dead Twilight. Me feel from here!

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Twilight Maulers and $2oa Twilight Firecallers for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.

complete.text: Skullbasher belong to real ogre. Someday Clugfist pick new champion.

progress.text: What you want? Bring Skullbasher now!

complete.text:
Tiny $r kill Chogg'Zac?

<Clubtoe lets out a triumphant bellow that echoes through the caves.>

Clubtoe done smashing rock for tinies! Clubtoe done losing friends! Me Twilight no more!

progress.text: No more kill friends! Chogg'Zac die today!

complete.text:
An ogre uprising? And so soon after their own battle for freedom from the Twilight's Hammer? These warriors have nearly as bloody a history as our own. They will make for powerful allies if we can continue to gain their trust.

You've done well, $N. I suspect this is only the beginning of our dealings with the Bolder'ok clan.

accept.text:
As I've shadowed our enemy's movements, I have discovered a weakness among their ranks. Ogre dissidents have begun to rebel, seeking the same freedom as their Bolder'ok kin. Word of your deeds has spread. We must exploit this.

I spied a Bolder'ok warrior heading to the caves west of here in search of his brothers and sisters. Find him, and join his efforts to rally his people.

complete.text:
<Crag'rog readies his mace to attack before he takes a closer look at you.>

Wait... Crag'rog know you. You fight for Clugfist!

objectives.text: Look for the Bolder'ok ogre in the nearby cave.

accept.text:
When Crag'rog hear $r-ling free ogres, Crag'og want free ogres too.

With tiny $c here, we smash Twilight together. Break them bones. Make them scream. Free ogres! Then be home in time for stew.

complete.text:
We free many ogres. This good. We kill weak, coward ogres. That better.

Only one coward ogre left.

objectives.text: Recruit $1oa Ogre Miners.

accept.text:
When Clugfist leave Twilight, one ogre stand in way. Morg.

Morg massive ogre. Nearly as massive as Clugfist. But not massivest. He need tinies to protect him. Clugfist never got fair fight. Now WE no fight fair.

Find Morg. Bring many tinies with you. Kill him. Take mace back to Clugfist. Then Twilight know they challenge us no more!

complete.text:
Morg is dead! Tiny $r full of tricks. Clugfist like you.

Twilight's Hammer crumple beneath might of Bolder'ok. We free ogres!

objectives.text: Collect the Executioner's Mace from Executioner Morg in the Twilight Shroud for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.

progress.text: Crag'rog say you join him in fight. What you bring mighty Clugfist?

accept.text:
I'm tellin' ya, I can't pay Friz back! I got nothin' left but the shirt off my back!

Why are you lookin' at me like that...

objectives.text: Bring Tazzik's Sweaty Shirt to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.

progress.text: Lackey? Why are you givin' me this...

complete.text:
Tiny $r not turn purple! Hurray!

But... where friends?

accept.text:
Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid.

Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it.

Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should.

complete.text: Clubtoe feel better already! You smash lots of shiny pictures? Were others mad?

objectives.text: Destroy $1oa Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.

accept.text:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

$n, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.

complete.text: Excellent, this is exactly what I need. I have read this tablet before, but that was when I was a young $r. It's been many moons since then and my memory is not what it used to be.
Excellent, this is exactly what I need. I have read this tablet before, but that was when I was a young troll. It's been many moons since then and my memory is not what it used to be.

objectives.text: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.

progress.text:
Have you found the tablet?

I hope the Bloodscalp didn't give you too much trouble. If they did, I hope you killed them for it.

accept.text:
After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.

In my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.

I have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.

Go and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.

complete.text:
<Kin'weelay listens intently as you describe what you have seen.>

You are sure you saw the naga coming and going from this cavern ruin? Though what could they be looking for?

Perhaps it is connected to I'lalai after all. If this is the case, this could be the discovery of the century, $N! The Lost City has been a place of myth and legend for as long as any $r can remember.

But now it is possible the myth could be reality. There is no time to waste; we must investigate.

<Kin'weelay listens intently as you describe what you have seen.>

You are sure you saw the naga coming and going from this cavern ruin? Though what could they be looking for?

Perhaps it is connected to I'lalai after all. If this is the case, this could be the discovery of the century, $N! The Lost City has been a place of myth and legend for as long as any troll can remember.

But now it is possible the myth could be reality. There is no time to waste; we must investigate.

objectives.text: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.

accept.text:
$C, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.

complete.text:
Good work. You are quickly proving your worth to the Horde with your work here, $c.

Planting these tridents outside the gates of Grom'gol will send a message that the Horde is not to be trifled with.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.

progress.text: The more reports I get about these well-armed naga, the more I want them gone. Have you taken care of the problem?

accept.text:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $c, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.

complete.text:
<Kin'weelay's hands shake as you hand him the rubbings.>

This is ancient Zandali but it is still legible, even to me. These four tablets speak of the ancient city, though I have never heard this account before.

Nor have I ever heard of the Loa of Tides. I thought all of the serpents depicted at the edges of the tablets were the loa Hethiss, but to my knowledge his avatar does not have a cobra hood or fins.

Could this then be a depiction of the Loa of Tides? It almost looks more like a sea serpent.

objectives.text: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.

accept.text:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.

complete.text:
I see you have returned. I take it to mean you have slain their leader?

Good. One less thing for us to worry about here. You have done well, $c.

objectives.text: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.

accept.text:
Hey pal, you look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

Baron Revilgaz has me keep'n my ear to the ground for magical objects. Word on the street is that a sunken troll ruin has mysteriously become, eh, un-sunk, which means there are a lot of unclaimed goods, if you catch my meaning.

Problem is, it's also caught the eye of pirates! Not just any pirates, the Saltseers specifically collect magical artifacts. I need you to go into the Drowned City, clear them out and take their stolen artifacts.

complete.text:
Excellent! I'll let the Baron know right away.

As promised, here's your share of the reward.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.

progress.text: Heya! Have you had a chance to take care of those blasted pirates yet? I have a crew standing by to go plunder-- er, explore the troll ruins.

accept.text:
The Saltseer pirates have been a thorn in my side recently and knowing they're in the Drowned City makes it worse! I mean they're always bad news, but there is one captain in particular I want outta the picture. That damned Captain Dreadrise!

He and his crew are very accomplished at gathering all the magical artifacts I've been after, and I'm tired of the competition.

I want you to remove Captain Dreadrise and his Saltseer Coroners from the picture. Permanently.

complete.text:
I can't thank you enough! I will be able to sleep better knowing there are fewer of those Saltseers around.

I know the Baron also appreciates your service. Here's your bounty.

objectives.text: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.

accept.text:
If you wanna land a big score, you gotta go where others wouldn't dare! This cave behind me's rich with untapped mineral deposits. I'm talkin' BIG bucks if we can get a crew in there.

There's just this... teeny tiny... dragon problem. It's nothing, really.

If you're willing to go in there and save me the hassle of clearing the dragons out, there's a nice reward in it for you. Not to mention, you'll be in the good graces of a future mining tycoon!

complete.text: Terrific work, $c. Once my little mining venture turns a profit I promise I'll cut ya in!

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Cinderscale Whelps and $2oa Cinderscale Warriors for Gelinda Coppergleam.

accept.text:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!

complete.text: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>

objectives.text: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!

progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>

accept.text:
An Alliance scouting party has been seen on a small island northeast of Rog'mar. They are led by a scoutmaster who has made tracking enemy movements increasingly difficult. The bastard even named his filthy pet after me as an open mockery. He knows I'm hunting him.

This human has eyes everywhere, and they need to be put out. I already claimed one before he managed to flee. Bring me his other as proof that the scoutmaster is no more. Show him he is not as untouchable as he thinks.

-- Neza Bloodsnout

objectives.text: Bring the Scoutmaster's Eye to Neza Bloodsnout in Rog'mar.

progress.text: Keep your voice down. The humans are always watching.

complete.text: Wowee! Now that'll turn some heads! Nice job diggin' this up. There's a place on the mining team for ya, if you're ever interested.

progress.text: To be honest, I'm not sure if cubic draconia can just be yanked outta the ground with your hands. If you have trouble gettin' some, come back here and I'll lend you some dynamite.

accept.text:
'Ey boss-$Gmon:lady;, ya need help from ol' Tan'jani? Don't worry about it, I fix you up good.

Orcs be good at hittin' humans with axes, but when you wanna stick 'em before dey see ya comin', that's when you call on the headhunters. You wanna learn to stick 'em too? I see it in your eyes, heheh.

First we get you your own spears. Dis one's mine. Go to the human camp to de west and take their wood. Take knife with ya. You can sharpen their lumber into good spears for stickin'. Den bring 'em back.

complete.text: Nice and sharp. Dey gonna stick good.

objectives.text: Collect Wood Bundles from Peasant Woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp then fletch them into $1oa Makeshift Stickin' Spears.

progress.text: Whatchu find?

accept.text:
You got de spears, now ya gonna learn how to throw dem.

De Riverglades be full o' crocolisks. Nasty tings. Snap you up if ya ain't quick. Perfect for target practice, heheh.

Go stick yourself a bunch of dem. Den you come back to ol' Tran'jani for ya prize. If ya can stick a crocolisk, ya can stick any'ting.

complete.text: Impressive work, mon. Ya got de makin's of a real headhunter in ya. Just remember ol' Tan'jani when ya make it big, haha!

objectives.text: Impale $1oa Freshwater Crocolisks then return to Tran'jani in Rog'mar.

accept.text:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
Dese waters be treacherous. My headhunters keep the paths clear as dey can, but there be a beasty stalkin' de rivers even we cannot catch. Excitin', eh?

Boss say we gotta clear it out, so we got a little competition goin'. Find de white one patrollin' de rivers and bring me its fang. Whoever sticks this slippery crocolisk win de whole pot. Just don't get snapped yourself, heheh!

-- Tan'jani

complete.text: Taz'dingo! You be a skilled hunter if ya caught ol' Ghostmaw.

objectives.text: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani in Rog'mar.

progress.text: Ya look like ya seen a ghost, mon. Heheheh.

accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.

complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

objectives.text: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

complete.text: Excellent work, $N! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!

progress.text: What do you have there, $r?

accept.text:
Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.

complete.text:
The crystals are in a few more pieces than I was expecting, but this looks to be all of it. I will hold onto these for the moment. Thank you, $N.

Your next step will be to gather mana that is malleable enough to serve as both an adhesive for the broken pieces, and a conduit for the leylines to surge through thereafter.

It is quite a remarkable process, but gathering the mana may prove to be an inconvenience.

objectives.text: Recover shards and fragments of the pylons, found guarded at the Magram and Gelkis villages. Return them to Mordent Evenshade.

progress.text: I would rather not further draw the centaur's attention toward me or my fallen kin, else I would seek out the crystals myself.

accept.text:
You may have seen the floating sparks of mana scattered throughout Shen'dralas. This is a new phenomenon, likely the result of the damage the pylons have endured.

We need this mana back in a semicrystallized form. We can accomplish this by using the Mana Sieve found within the temple. Borrow the sieve and collect any floating mana orbs you find.

The temple's denizens will not appreciate their precious artifact being borrowed without their consent, but they will understand in time.

complete.text:
I see you have successfully repaired the pylons--how could I not notice?

<Mordent gestures up and toward the skies, his gaze briefly followed in that direction as well. As his attention returns to you, he lofts his brow as he takes note of your seemingly lesser levels of enthusiasm.>

objectives.text: Acquire the Mana Sieve from within the temple in Shen'dralas and use it to collect Ancient Mana Crystals. Once you have acquired enough mana, empower the pylons and return to Mordent Evenshade.

progress.text: It is good to see you again, $N.

accept.text:
Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock.

Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks.

Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.

objectives.text: Deliver $1oa Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok.

accept.text:
The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.

complete.text: Excellent! These'll do real nice. Now, whaddya say to just one more favor?

objectives.text: Gather 5 Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.
Gather 8 Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.

progress.text: I hope you don't mind if I keep ya on a need-to-know basis about the finer details of my invention. Gotta protect my trade secrets, y'know?

accept.text:
You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!

complete.text:
Dang, the two of you really went at it! Couldn't have asked for a better show, and I got some great notes to boot.

I'll fix up ol' G45 here and make some changes to the engine. He'll be ready to go again in no time.

Test, tweak, test, tweak. Such is the life of a great inventor.

objectives.text: Help Sleebo test his creation.

accept.text:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to a hunter at Rog'mar and see what they know.

complete.text:
<Neza runs her fingers along the markings left on the skull. Her smile grows as she does so.>

Two pieces of good news. First, this is a human skull. Second, we have a great hunt on our hands.

objectives.text: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

progress.text: You bring something from the plains?

accept.text:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride.

I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound.

There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin!

complete.text: Good find, $c. I will only need a moment to carve this into the proper shape.

objectives.text: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

progress.text: I have been making whistles and animal calls since I was young. It is a useful skill when hunting certain prey.

accept.text:
The whistle is made, $n.

Take it and go to the top of the hill south where the lions dwell.

Once you are ready to face your quarry, blow the whistle and the beast should appear.

I wish you luck in your hunt. May you return in glory.

complete.text:
And so you are! Well done!

These plains are a tough land, $N. You have shown yourself to be even tougher.

objectives.text: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

progress.text: Come to bring news of your victory?

accept.text:
A hunter goes through more arrows in her lifetime than there are stars in the sky.

Personally, I make mine by hand. I only trust my own work.

The coarse feathers of the nearby buzzards make for excellent fletching. Would you aid me by collecting a few?

complete.text: These will catch the wind nicely. My arrows will fly true. Thank you, $c.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Plains Buzzard Feathers to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

progress.text: A bit ironic to pluck something from the corpse of a buzzard, isn't it?

accept.text:
Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey.

This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job.

Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter.

The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it.

complete.text: This is enough venom to kill a kodo in minutes--or a human in seconds. In either case, I am eager to put it to use.

objectives.text: Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

progress.text: Be careful while gathering the vipers' venom that you do not succumb to it yourself.

accept.text:
As important as a hunter's weapons is her quiver. A good quiver holds many arrows, while not being so large as to slow the wearer down. It must be durable, and fit snugly onto the body.

Around here, there is no better material for a quiver than the pelts of lions. They are already well-suited for the life of a hunter on the plains.

The lions gather on a hill to the south. You can see it from here. Please, bring me their pelts.

complete.text:
Arrows, poison, and a quiver to hold it all. You have made quite the hunter's kit here.

Please, take something in exchange for your labor. May it serve you well out in the field.

objectives.text: Gather 6 Prized Lion Hides for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

progress.text: Like us, the lions hunt in packs. Be on your guard, and make sure you are not surrounded.

accept.text:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.

complete.text: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.

objectives.text: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.

progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?

accept.text:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.

complete.text:
Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her.

Rest assured I will take great care of this dagger.

objectives.text: Defeat $1oa Young Black Ravagers and $2oa Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.

progress.text: What have you got there?

accept.text:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.

complete.text:
Merrick Valor, you say? Poor boy always wanted to prove himself. It was a shame what happened to him and his family.

Thank you for bringing this, $N. Perhaps it can shed some additional light on Raven Hill's history.
