objectives.text: Defeat $1oa Splinter Fist Warriors and $2oa Splinter Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.

progress.text: Yes, what is it?

accept.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.

complete.text:
This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.

I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.

objectives.text: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.

progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.

accept.text:
A second wave of Naga was approaching the keep when we were falling back. I suspect that the battle is still raging inside. 

We Kor'kron play blood for blood. If you are going in there anyway, I want you to kill any Naga you see. I saw a sorceress among them as well, and you can bet that was their leader. Bring me her head.

We lost a lot of good orcs today and I won't rest easy knowing that we didn't give as good as we got.

objectives.text: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sergeant Ulka.

accept.text:
Most of the humans we fought wore blood red bandanas. I seem to recall hearing of a criminal organization operating in the Eastern Kingdoms known as 'The Defias Brotherhood' who are known for their red masks. Why they are active here in Kalimdor I don't know, but kill any that cross your path and bring their masks to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. 

He'll be able to determine if these are in fact Defias masks.

objectives.text: Enter Alcaz Prison and collect $1oa Blood Red Bandanas from the human guards there.

accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

objectives.text: Sit near Kaga's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

objectives.text: Sit near Eleanor's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.

accept.text:
$n, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

objectives.text: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.

accept.text:
$n, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.

complete.text:
I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

objectives.text: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.

accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.

accept.text:
Wait, $n. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?

complete.text:
Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

objectives.text: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.

progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Speak with Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn to become a cook.

complete.text:
Good goin', $c. This be exactly what I'm needin'.

Let's just keep this little transaction between us, ya? What Muln and the others don't know, won't be hurtin' nobody!

progress.text: How you doin' mon? Job done yet?

accept.text:
Ol' Mazu'kon got a bone to pick with a Witch Doctor that go by the name of Zum'rah and I be thinkin' you can help me out with that. 

Zum'rah practice all his bad voodoo in the Sandfury city of Zul'Farrak, far to the south in the deserts of Tanaris. Go there. Kill Zum'rah, and bring me his head.

Trust me mon, the world be a better place with his head stuck on pike outside my hut than it be sittin' on his shoulders.

objectives.text: Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.

progress.text: Bad voodoo is bad for ya. Remember that, mon.

accept.text:
I have had a vision.

Deep in the place known as Maraudon, past the earth song falls, there is a chamber filled with brilliant white crystals and guarded by mighty giants. At the highest part of this chamber is a crystal of exceptional brilliance. It is an aspect of the sun god, the right eye of the Earthmother herself--An'she.

I've dreamed of its radiance and it calls to me. $c, remove An'she's Radiance from that place and bring it here where it belongs, under the open skies of Mulgore.

objectives.text: Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.

progress.text:
An'she is the physical manifestation of the sun's radiance. Some say he is the right eye of the Earthmother, and a force of pure, cleansing light. Without An'she, the shu'halo would live forever in darkness and despair. 

I have devoted myself to the sun god's service and hope to spread his light to all of our people in time.

complete.text:
You say that all this fell off a zeppelin crash up at the northern side of the jungle, and Bloodscalp trolls had their hands on it? This was supposed to arrive at Powderfuse Port SIX WEEKS ago! We even struck a deal with Grom'gol to use their zeppelin tower for expedited shipping!

I wondered why Whizzbuzz has been sending me snarky letters. We should have never let Zimmix behind the wheel after what happened the last time.

Great. Just great. Take this and leave, I have insurance claims to file.

progress.text: You look confused. Lost?

accept.text:
You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!

I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!

I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!

Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.

complete.text:
Is that the key?

<Zimmix lunges forward against the front of the cage and he repeatedly attempts to swipe the key from your possession.>

Just hand it over!

objectives.text: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.

progress.text:
Listen, I like you and all, but you standing around here is making us look suspicious! If you don't have the key then, I dunno, GO GET IT!

Please?

accept.text:
Wait, wait, don't go yet!

I know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here!

You've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh?

complete.text:
Oh my gold. YOU were the one that rescued Zimmix?

Your timing could not have been worse. We just had a celebratory toast thinking he was finally out of our hair for good, and we have another critical delivery coming up that has yet to be assigned. Of course, he's already trying to claim it and, of course, I have to argue against it or we risk another one of his big blunders!

Word of advice: If you see a goblin trapped in a cage, they probably deserve it. Just leave them there next time.

objectives.text: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.

accept.text:
As much as I don't like the guy, I've heard what the Bloodscalp tribe do to their prisoners, and it ain't pretty. I'm glad Zimmix made it out alright.

However, I have another urgent delivery and I do NOT trust him to take it on. The problem? Nobody else will be available to take this before he does. You, however, have rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, so you're looking pretty trustworthy from down here.

Any chance I can convince you to take this to Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port?

complete.text:
Huh? What you got for me?

<Whizzbuzz peeks inside the crate and his expression immediately lights up with surprise.>

Look't this! Lozgil finally pulled through. It only took a scathing letter and payin' the courier to threaten him to get the point across. Wonder what his excuse is. Did the ship's captain get captured? Did a zeppelin crash?

Haha, could you imagine? We don't even have a zeppelin tower around here!

You look like you went through a lot to deliver this, so have a reward.

objectives.text: Deliver the Twice Reordered Package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

progress.text: Can't you see I'm busy?

accept.text:
$n! Your arrival is timely, as always.

You have provided valuable assistance to the defense of Grom'gol, and we are grateful. After your recent push against the ogres nearby, we sent out a scout to see if there are more out there that may try to enact vengeance against us. As it turns out, there is a cave far to the east that they have claimed as their hovel.

Gather a friend or two and make it very clear that we will not tolerate another threat to our settlement, now or ever!

objectives.text: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill ogres at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.

accept.text:
Hi, can you help me?

My parents finally let me come along with them to this big jungle and they even let me pick a few plants just outside the gates. I'm trying to study herbalism so I can be an alchemist one day!

Anyway, I almost filled my backpack when a bunch of huge, angry weeds came out of nowhere and started spitting at me!

I ran away, and I'm fine, but now they won't let me play outside of the camp anymore. Can you make it safe for me, and then tell my mum?

complete.text:
Ah, I should have suspected that little Gemmy would try to persuade someone to help out with his situation.

Unfortunately, that was too close of a call when he was out last, and I don't even know what else might be lurking out there.

No, he will not be allowed to step another foot past those gates for another ten years or so. In fact, once his father is back from Booty Bay, he will be heading straight back to Durotar.

You don't have to deliver the news to him, I'll do that.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Carnivorous Weeds south of Grom'gol and then inform Gemmil's mother.

accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of $C's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.

objectives.text:
Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.

Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.

accept.text:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.

complete.text:
Splendid spider string. When you're being stitched back together, a little infection is the... least of your concerns.

Ahem, excuse me once again. Doctor humor.

Thanks for helping out the medical ward, $N. If only we could get this kind of help more regularly.

objectives.text: Return 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.

progress.text:
The results are in, I've got good news and bad news for you.

Oh, excuse me.

accept.text:
I noticed a few rocks that seemed unusual in the Dustbowl. Upon closer inspection, I saw that they had carvings! I could not resist making rubbings of them to study later.

The nearby ogres took notice of my presence and before I could even react, I woke up under the care of the innkeeper, and with a terrible headache.

Now, I am down all of my supplies and without any study material while I heal. Can you venture to the east in search of my pack, and take rubbings of the etchings yourself?

objectives.text: Slay ogres in the Dustbowl for Mus'hale's Stolen Supplies and use them to collect rubbings of the nearby stone etchings, then return to Mus'hale at Kargath.

accept.text:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied $r. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.

objectives.text: Travel to Sunnyglade in the Riverglades and recover the tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques.

complete.text:
Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.

We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.

accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

objectives.text: Speak with Gelman Stonehand in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

objectives.text: Speak with Brek Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

accept.text:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.

objectives.text: Speak with Graham Van Talen in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Speak with Nurse Neela in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

objectives.text: Speak with Brom Killian in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

objectives.text: Speak with Nyassa Swiftdraught in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Speak with Naleeia Tattermend in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.

objectives.text: Speak with Syriel Nightrain in Valanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

complete.text:
Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!

This heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.

Ah, I love it when a plan comes together.

progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.

accept.text:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.

objectives.text: High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok.

complete.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.

accept.text:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.

complete.text:
The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.

I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, $N!

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Greater Tarantulas and destroy $2oa Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.

accept.text:
If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.

complete.text:
May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.

They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.

Light be with you.

objectives.text: Free $1oa Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.

accept.text:
Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.

complete.text:
Ah, this is most valuable knowledge. I thank you for your efforts.

<Morin looks through the notes.>

It seems our next move is clear.

objectives.text: Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.

progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?

accept.text:
The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.

Entire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millennia--erased in days.

We will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.

$n, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.

objectives.text: Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.

accept.text:
Hail, $c. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?

objectives.text: Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.

complete.text: Your training can now begin in earnest, $c. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.

objectives.text: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.

progress.text: Through pain comes resolve.

accept.text:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.

complete.text: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.

objectives.text: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.

accept.text:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.

complete.text:
You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.

I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!

Today marks a great victory for our village, and a sense of security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young $c.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Galak Centaurs, $2oa Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.

progress.text: Is the deed done?

accept.text:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.

complete.text: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!

objectives.text: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.

accept.text:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.

objectives.text: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!

complete.text:
<Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>

This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, $N.

objectives.text: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.

progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?

accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

complete.text:
You honor me with your abilities, $c. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.

objectives.text: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.

accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.

complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.

objectives.text: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.

progress.text: Any catches to speak of?

accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.

complete.text: I can hear their warbling from here--it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Murlocs and $2oa Murloc Streamrunner at Crystal Lake, then return to Jason Mathers.

accept.text:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.

complete.text:
I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.

I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.

objectives.text: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.

accept.text:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.

complete.text:
Give me just a minute...

It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Vials of Animal Blood and $2oa Duskweed Petals for murloc bait, then return to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.

progress.text: Find everything?

accept.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.

complete.text: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.

objectives.text: Return to Jason Mathers.

accept.text:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--$n, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.

complete.text:
There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.

You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.

objectives.text: Punish $1oa Deathguards for Executor Zygand.

accept.text:
Make no mistake, $c--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.

objectives.text: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.

accept.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.

complete.text:
An interesting collection. These should work well enough!

Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.

progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?

accept.text:
While I watched in horror as you frolicked through the haunted woods with my precious relic, your meddling did inspire an idea.

The unstable rifts you encountered are the precursors to our pylon guards. We have been unable to conjure more for centuries, and I worry what might happen when those that remain inevitably flicker out.

I know it seems counterintuitive, but see if you can find another pylon protector nearly on the verge of collapse and recover their Crystal Heart. I'll explain more after.

complete.text:
You were successful, I see! And what a heart you recovered. I am excited to know that the passing of centuries did little to tarnish the craftsmanship of this gemstone.

Most importantly, this is a promising discovery. It would seem that, indeed, mana is temporary, but gemstones are forever.

Are you eager to learn what comes next?

objectives.text: Slay a Decrepit Pylon Protector for their Depleted Crystal Heart and bring it to Historian Biraxas within the temple of Shen'dralas.

progress.text: I assure you I am not looking to sabotage one of our only means of defense. If a protector does not look as lively and well-nourished as those in our temple, then they are on the last hundred years or so of their lifecycle. If anything, it is a mercy killing.

accept.text:
While sourcing the gems necessary to conjure the elementals is a challenge itself, the bigger concern is whether there is still enough loose mana in Shen'dralas to create them. With this heart, we can confirm once and for all whether we need to begin researching other means of defense.

For you, the task is simple. Simply toss this gem into one of those unstable rifts. If we're lucky, you'll have a fight on your hands. Don't feel compelled to hold back, if it works once, it will work again.

objectives.text: Throw the Depleted Crystal Heart into an Unstable Mana Rift. Return to Historian Biraxas within the temple of Shen'dralas with proof of success or failure.

accept.text: Help, $n! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.$B$BWill you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.$B$BTo feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.

complete.text: Fantastic work, $N! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.

objectives.text: Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.$B$BFeed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
